  > 1. **k* bounds:** fixed. In `ct_kstar.csv` (and `inner_kstar*.csv`, `scope_ct_kstar.csv`) `k_emp_lo/hi` are grid values (lower/higher percentile of the bootstrap curves); 9999 = not reached on the grid (up to 109); `frac_boot_never` is the share of bootstrap curves that never reach it. The old `kstar.csv` is now `kstar_rms.csv` (interpolated bounds, secondary).
  > 2. **Headline:** the common target set. Use `ct_curves.csv`, `ct_contrast.csv`, `ct_kstar.csv`, `ct_excess_curve_ct_<split>_<fixed|all>.csv`, `ct_decomposition.csv` (split G/T/S; subset `fixed` = the k_max=109 models, the headline). Old files are `*_rms.csv`, labelled secondary. S2 is in `ct_curves.csv`; on C/T no rule falls below its floor at small k (it can at large k on T and S: floor is at the LOO-selected rank).
  > 3. **Spectrum:** your labels are right (pairwise-complete correlation matrix of the standardised full matrix, descriptive; `pa95` = permutation parallel analysis; cv-vs-rank `rmse` = inner group-CV RMSE, standardised, reveal = all other benchmarks of the run set, mean over the 10 G folds, bounds = mean ± 1.645 se over folds).
  > 4. **New:** Fig. 3 → `ct_decomposition.csv` (real) and `synth/synth_summary.csv`, `synth/synth_estimation_fit.csv` (synthetic: `est_term` vs `M`, `misfit`, ladder rungs in `level`); `ladder/ladder_diagnostics.csv` + `ladder_placement.json` (the real matrix is "outside the ladder"; draw no real marker on a rung). Fig. 4 → `scope_ct_curves.csv`, `scope_ct_kstar.csv` (G folds 0-3 only, 20 splits; k* in fractions of each condition's floor). Table 3 → still running (`ctx`, S0/S6/S3/S5/S6s/S7 and P2-P6 on 20 splits); I will post it here. Also post hoc: `inner_kstar.csv`, `floor_by_rank.csv`, `floor_misfit_summary.csv`, `sens_randomfold/` — label them post hoc / sensitivity.
  > Not computable as listed: `random-k draw spread` is `rmse_sd_splits` (sd over C/T splits), not over random-k draws; the T1 predicted curve exists only for S6/S0 with P5.
